technical_quality: Adequate: PA upright, good inspiration (~9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation, adequate penetration; apices included, scapulae mostly cleared from lung fields.

devices.type: lead film marker (mirrored letters, external artifact)
devices.location: upper right corner of image (patient's left, outside the thorax)

abnormalities.finding: Ill-defined hazy opacity adjacent to and partially silhouetting the left heart border (lingular / medial left lower lobe region), ~6 cm
Left hemidiaphragm slightly higher than the right (mild elevation)
Mottled gas/food residue within the gastric fundus below the left hemidiaphragm (incidental)

description_zh: PA 胸部X光，吸氣量足夠，無明顯旋轉。左下肺野內側、緊鄰左心緣處可見一片邊界不清的模糊浸潤影，部分遮蔽左心緣（silhouette sign），疑為舌葉／左下葉實變，範圍約 6 公分；右肺野清晰，雙側肋膈角銳利。左側橫膈略高於右側，其下胃泡內見混雜食物殘渣影。心臟大小正常、縱膈不寬，未見氣胸、肋膜積液或任何導管、引流管或植入裝置，僅影像右上角見鉛字標記。
